original_query: Is man or machine the formal part of value creation?

confirmed.answer_text: The 'Formal part of value creation' is labeled as 'machine'.
confirmed.summary: The page explains the 'Taylor Bathtub' graph, which depicts the historical evolution of market dynamics from the Age of Crafts Manufacturing to the Age of Global Markets. It contrasts the 'Dynamic part' of value creation (man) with the 'Formal part' of value creation (machine), showing how these components have shifted over time.
key_facts: The 'Formal part of value creation' is labeled as 'machine'.
